experience.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern (Lead Intern, FTTH Analytics Team)
achievements: Built Python pipelines processing 28.2M daily signal readings across 446,000 customers, consolidating multi-source operational data (RX/TX signals, ACS exports, fault tickets) into a validated Parquet dataset used by three modelling workstreams.

Designed automated data-quality checks (invalid-reading removal, per-customer interpolation of 580,195 rows and customer-day de-duplication) to guarantee a single trusted source for downstream analytics.

Developed an FTTH fault-prediction model (Isolation Forest, Autoencoders) detecting anomalies 3–7 days before failure; engineered 55+ temporal features and a 10-rule weighted risk engine, reaching 48% recall at 36% precision on a 433K-customer holdout month.
Cut daily false positives from ~378 to 70–90 through 7-day cooldown logic, making the alerts operationally usable by field teams.
Deployed an end-to-end AWS pipeline (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, EventBridge, CloudWatch, SES) and migrated its feature/preprocessing layer to a new api_v2 REST schema with zero production disruption.
Built Power BI dashboards for real-time operational monitoring, documented pipeline and schema changes, and onboarded 3 new team members.
